The Defective Detective - Album 5: Serah Asks

Missions Decisions

"Missions decisions Pick a trail"

[Verse 1] Morning board Too many cases Too many names in colored lines Missing Kin Missing objects Break-ins stacked across the signs

Keemaro looks at Serah “So what next, boss?”

Serah turns

“Don’t call me boss”

Nobody moves Nobody talks Everybody keeps staring still

Serah sighs

“Fine”

[pause]

“Let’s make this less stupid”

[Pre-Chorus] One board Three directions Too many threads to chase Serah starts dividing problems By who can get through which place

[Chorus] Missions decisions Pick a trail Pick a door Who stays back Who goes looking Who finds out what they’re looking for Missions decisions No grand plan No command Just enough of us to cover Every clue we understand

[Verse 2] Yuki steps forward quickly

“I can go”

Serah answers

“No”

Yuki frowns

“I came here to help”

“You are helping”

Serah points toward intake

“Stay Learn Andy teaches you the cases”

Andy blinks

“I do?”

Serah says

“You do now”

Tikka exhales

“Thank you”

Yuki looks at Tikka

“Traitor”

Tikka smiles

“Alive traitor”

[Pre-Chorus] Foxxie stays on comms and calls Keep the lines alive Andy, Yuki run intake Learn who came and why

[Chorus] Missions decisions Pick a trail Pick a door Who stays back Who goes looking Who finds out what they’re looking for Missions decisions No grand plan No command Just enough of us to cover Every clue we understand

[Verse 3] Serah points at Nessa

“You’re with me We chase Malak”

Nessa nods

“I need equipment”

Serah groans

“Of course you do”

“Deep-frequency scanner Portable residue analyzer And the good soldering kit”

Coda looks up

“You said two things”

Nessa shrugs

“I remembered three”

Coda stands

“I’ll get them Need supplies back home anyway”

Serah says

“Black Zone?”

Coda nods

“Quick trip”

“Bring the good kit”

“I heard her”

[Break] Rikka leans against the table Kamira lifts a stack of files

Serah points

“You two Missing-person overlaps”

Keemaro nods

“I’ll make the calls Some higher clients will let you in If they know you’re coming”

Serah says

“That helps”

Keemaro looks at Rikka Then Kamira

“Please behave”

[pause]

Rikka smiles

“What counts as behave?”

Kamira adds

“Important clarification”

Keemaro closes his eyes

“I already regret this”

[Verse 4] Keemaro gathers up his sons

“We’ll work from our office Feed you anything we find”

Keeko takes three folders Keewee grabs the maps Junior carries one chair

Serah asks

“Why the chair?”

Junior says

“Evidence”

Keemaro says

“Put it back”

Foxxie checks the comms again

“Lines are live”

Andy sorts the newest cases Yuki sits beside him

“Where do we start?”

Andy hands her a file

“With the name”

Yuki reads it carefully

Then nods

“Okay”

[Pre-Chorus] Serah looks around the room Every team now knows its lane Nobody asked for leadership Everybody waits the same

[Final Chorus] Missions decisions Pick a trail Pick a door Kamira, Rikka chase the missing Keemaro opens floors Missions decisions Foxxie holds the line Andy, Yuki learn the stories One case at a time

Coda heads back to the Black Zone Nessa packs for Malak’s trail Serah checks the board once more

“Stay in contact Don’t go stale”

Missions decisions No title No command Just a fox who hates being followed

While everybody follows the plan

[Outro] Doors start opening Teams start leaving Files disappear from the wall

Keemaro pauses at the doorway

“Good call, boss”

Serah points at him

“I swear to Fox”

[pause]

Keemaro leaves

Nessa grins

“Boss”

Serah grabs her coat

“Keep walking.”
